questions.prompt: The old man was hearing the sad guest's complaint through the walls at night.
questions.answer: Senex querellam hospitis trīstis per parietēs noctū audiēbat.

questions.prompt: When the general had fortified the camp, the soldiers were sleeping safely.
questions.answer: Cum imperātor castra mūnīvisset, mīlitēs tūtō dormiēbant.

questions.prompt: We shall punish the traitors who opened the gates to the enemy.
questions.answer: Prōditōrēs quī portās hostibus aperuērunt pūniēmus.

questions.prompt: Let the guards watch the sleeping city with keen eyes.
questions.answer: Custōdēs urbem dormientem oculīs ācribus custōdiant.

questions.prompt: Having heard the shout, the fishermen came quickly to the shore.
questions.answer: Clāmōre audītō, piscātōrēs celeriter ad lītus vēnērunt.

questions.prompt: The judge punished the thief severely, although the crowd was shouting.
questions.answer: Iūdex fūrem graviter pūnīvit, quamquam turba clāmābat.

questions.prompt: We were feeling a great cold in the dark forest at first light.
questions.answer: Magnum frīgus in silvā ātrā prīmā lūce sentiēbāmus.

questions.prompt: Guard the sacred fire, maidens, lest the temple grow cold.
questions.answer: Ignem sacrum custōdīte, virginēs, nē templum frīgēscat.

questions.prompt: The soldiers will hear the general's voice before dawn.
questions.answer: Mīlitēs vōcem ducis ante aurōram audient.

questions.prompt: Although we heard the truthful witness, doubt remained.
questions.answer: Quamquam veridicum testem audīvimus, dubium mānsit.

questions.prompt: Let the judge hear both sides with a calm mind.
questions.answer: Iūdex utramque partem aequō animō audiat.

questions.prompt: Hear me, citizens, while I explain the ancient laws.
questions.answer: Audīte mē, cīvēs, dum veterēs lēgēs explicō.

questions.prompt: The old men had heard the rumor spreading through the crowd.
questions.answer: Senēs fāmam per turbam sē diffundentem audīverant.

questions.prompt: When the shepherd had heard the wolves, he gathered the sheep.
questions.answer: Cum pāstor lupōs audīvisset, ovēs collēgit.

questions.prompt: You were hearing the pine forest murmuring in the wind.
questions.answer: Pīneam silvam ventō murmurantem audiēbās.

questions.prompt: We shall hear the truth from the truthful old man.
questions.answer: Vēritātem ā veridicō sene audiēmus.

questions.prompt: The maidens were hearing sweet songs from the hidden grove.
questions.answer: Virginēs dulcia carmina ex occultō nemore audiēbant.

questions.prompt: May you hear the words of the wise with an upright mind.
questions.answer: Verba sapientium ērēctō animō audiās.

questions.prompt: Hear the counsel of your father, my son.
questions.answer: Audī cōnsilium patris tuī, mī fīlī.

questions.prompt: The enemies had heard that the city was being betrayed.
questions.answer: Hostēs urbem prōdī audīverant.

questions.prompt: Let us hear the veteran soldiers relating their deeds.
questions.answer: Veterānōs mīlitēs rēs gestās nārrantēs audiāmus.
